english_source_note: Etemadi's Proof of the Strong Law of Large Numbers
callout_id: Etemadi关于强大数定律的证明#3
english_title: Proposition 1: Equivalent Form of the Strong Law of Large Numbers
statement_en: Prove that $$\frac{T_n}{n}=\frac{\sum_{i\leq n}Y_i}{n}$$ converges almost everywhere to $E(X_1)=\mu$, where $X_1,\ldots,X_n,\ldots$ are independent and identically distributed nonnegative random variables, and $Y_i = X_i\mathbf{1}_{|X_i|\leq i}$.
prerequisites: strong and weak laws of large numbers
independent and identically distributed random variables
callout_body: 证明$$\frac{T_n}{n}=\frac{\sum_{i\leq n}Y_i}{n}$$是几乎处处收敛到$E(X_1)=\mu$的，其中$X_1,...,X_n,...$是独立同分布的非负随机变量,$Y_i = X_i\mathbf{1}_{|X_i|\leq i}$.
